item.title: 2023 Manchester Road Race winner returns for 90th Thanksgiving Day event
item.description: Morgan Beadlescomb. 29, of Loveland, Colo., who won the 2023 Manchester Road Race, has entered the 2026 race for the event's 90th year. (Courtesy of Manchester Road Race Committee) MANCHESTER - A former Manchester Road Race winner will be returning this Thanksgiving Day to compete in the race's 2026 event. Officials from the Manchester Road Race Committee said in a news release that "only three athletes have ever run the Manchester Road Race course in a time under 21 minutes during the past 89 years." Morgan Beadlescomb, 29, of Loveland, Colo., won the 2023 race with a time of 21:12, according to the race's website . Shortly after the race, he proposed to his girlfriend Lexi Heger near the finish line, the release said. "Morgan has a wonderful history at our race and we are really pleased that he'll be competing here again this Thanksgiving," said Tris Carta, president of the Manchester Road Race Committee. At the 2025 race, Beadlescomb broke the 21-minute barrier with a third-place finish behind Edwin Kurgat, who won with a time of 20:54, followed by David Mullarkey with a time of 20:58, according to the committee's news release. Beadlescomb crossed the line with a time of 20:59. That same year, Beadlescomb won the right to represent the Manchester Road Race at its "twin" race, the Great Manchester Run in the United Kingdom, according to the release. With a time of 27:45, he finished fourth in the 10K event in Manchester, England, last May. In 2022, Beadlescomb finished second place at the Manchester Road Race with a time of 21:05. Presented by Hartford HealthCare and organized by more than 400 volunteers, the 2026 Manchester Road Race will be held Thanksgiving Day at 10 a.m. The annual race will be held on a 4.737-mile loop through the central streets of Manchester, starting and finishing on Main Street in front of St. James Church. Registration is available online for $37 until Nov. 1, when the admission fee will increase to $40, and then to $42 on Nov. 21. Participants unable to make it to Manchester on Thanksgiving Day can sign up for the race's virtual option, said Danie Kennedy, registrar and executive board member of the Manchester Road Race Committee. Kennedy said participants can register for the online option for $30 and download the race app to track their progress. All registration closes at 11:59 p.m. Nov. 24, Kennedy said. Main Street will close at 5:30 a.m. the day of the race and remain closed until 11:30 a.m., according to the event's website. All roads intersecting the racecourse as well as exit ramps from Interstate 384 will be closed at 9 a.m., with normal traffic resuming after 11:30 a.m., the website said. All proceeds from this year's race will be split between Rebuilding Together of Manchester and Habitat for Humanity of North Central Connecticut. For more information, visit the Manchester Road Race website. This story includes prior Hearst Media Connecticut reporting. Sign up for the Connecticut Briefing from CT Insider.

item.title: Brendan Carr plans to let prisons jam cellphone signals
item.description: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr announced the agency will vote on November 19th on rules that would allow prisons to use signal jamming. Radiofrequency jammers are generally banned under Section 333 and the Communications Act of 1934, with few exceptions, and Carr has noted they've been permitted for use at some federal facilities already. Carr claims in a statement that jammers are needed because "For years, thousands upon thousands of contraband cellphones have been pouring into prisons, and some of the worst possible offenders have been using them to order hits, coordinate violent gang activity, and aid criminal enterprises." item.title: Anfernee Simons addresses shooting slump as 76ers wait for scoring spark
item.description: Anfernee Simons addresses shooting slump as 76ers wait for scoring spark originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Throughout his career, Anfernee Simons has shown how lethal he can be as a scorer. But in the last three games, the 76ers reserve has been out of sync, struggling to find a groove. He made just 3 of 21 shots, including 2-for-13 from three, in games against the Cleveland Cavaliers , Milwaukee Bucks , and Detroit Pistons . This follows Simons scoring 13 points on 5-for-10 shooting against the New York Knicks in the season opener after missing the entire preseason. “I think for the most part they’ve been good,” he said of his looks at the basket. “Obviously, not playing, you can see now a little bit, not playing and not being able to play in preseason kind of held me back a little bit. But just like I said before, you’re going to be able to see throughout these first 20 games how it’s going to look. I’ll be able to get comfortable with what type of shots I’ll get on a game-to-game basis, just getting comfortable with those types of looks.” The Sixers (3-1) are banking on that happening. The ninth-year veteran signed with the Sixers this offseason to spark scoring off the bench. In 448 career games, the combo guard has averaged 14.8 points and shot 38.0% from three. He believes missing preseason with a hamstring injury has kept him from developing a rhythm with his teammates. “Each and every game, I feel like it’s getting more and more comfortable,” Simons said. “After that, obviously, where your shot’s coming from, you know what your role is, how that feels on a game-to-game basis. And so it’s going to help me and the team as well, just get everybody comfortable on the court.” The 27-year-old will have a chance to snap out of his shooting slump when the Sixers face the Indiana Pacers Wednesday night at Gainbridge Field House. Simmons’ teammates are confident that he’ll eventually regain his shooting touch. “The biggest thing is he can score with the best of them,” Dean Wade said. “And for me, the biggest thing is that if I’m going to set a screen for him, I’m really holding that screen, getting a little of that space because he doesn’t need much space. He’s got a quick trigger, and he jumps high on his jump shot. So it’s hard [for defenders] to get to regardless.” For more NBA coverage, analysis and insights, subscribe to Keith Pompey’s Substack .

item.title: Ronaldo’s 2008 Ballon d’Or named best of all time in fan vote
item.description: By Efe Onodjae Cristiano Ronaldo’s 2008 Ballon d’Or-winning campaign has been voted the best in the history of the prestigious individual football award in a public poll organised to celebrate its 70th anniversary. The result was posted by football transfer journalist, Fabrizio Romano, in a Facebook post monitored by Vanguard. Ronaldo’s 2008 triumph topped the Ballon d’Or of All Time (BOAT) ranking, ahead of Lionel Messi’s 2012 edition, while the Portuguese forward’s 2017 campaign came third. Messi’s 2023 season occupied the fourth position, followed by Ronaldo’s 2016 campaign in fifth place. The ranking featured 32 editions of the award won by 10 football legends, with supporters voting for the individual campaigns they considered the greatest. Other editions featuring prominently in the top 10 included Ronaldo’s 2014 and 2013 victories, as well as Messi’s 2015, 2011 and 2009 campaigns. Brazilian legend Ronaldo Nazário’s 2002 triumph was ranked 13th, while Johan Cruyff’s 1974 victory came 17th. Michel Platini’s 1984 campaign occupied the 18th position, ahead of Franz Beckenbauer’s 1976 edition. Ronaldo won his first Ballon d’Or in 2008 while playing for Manchester United, following an outstanding season in which he scored 42 goals in all competitions and helped the English club win the Premier League and UEFA Champions League. The Portuguese forward subsequently won the award four more times, in 2013, 2014, 2016 and 2017, taking his career tally to five. Messi, meanwhile, holds the record for the most Ballon d’Or wins, with eight, including his 2023 triumph following Argentina’s victory at the 2022 FIFA World Cup. The BOAT ranking recognises individual Ballon d’Or-winning campaigns rather than awarding a new official Ballon d’Or or determining which player has enjoyed the greatest career. The result is also separate from the annual Ballon d’Or award, which is decided through a jury of specialist journalists. The poll has renewed debate among football supporters over the achievements of Ronaldo and Messi, whose rivalry has dominated discussions about the world’s best player for more than a decade. The post Ronaldo’s 2008 Ballon d’Or named best of all time in fan vote appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.description: © Sam Greene/The Enquirer / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images NFL Fantasy Football Week 8 2026 Start ‘Em Sit ‘Em: D/ST appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Fantasy football managers often spend hours debating which running back should fill a flex spot, only to have a defensive touchdown ultimately determine the matchup outcome. Team defenses are among the most unpredictable positions in fantasy football, as a single interception or strip sack can transform an otherwise disappointing performance into a weekly success. Week 8 presents a valuable opportunity to take advantage of this volatility . Several struggling offenses will face defenses capable of applying significant pressure, while some of the league’s most respected defenses are up against opponents that typically don’t allow easy fantasy points. Here are three defenses worth starting and three that fantasy managers should think about avoiding in Week 8. Start ‘Em: Bengals D/ST vs. Titans Cincinnati may seem like an unusual choice for a fantasy defense article, but their matchup against Tennessee provides a great opportunity for a productive performance . The Bengals have shown defensive inconsistencies this season, but their recent game against Baltimore highlighted their potential when both the pass rush and coverage are working together. Cincinnati held the Ravens to just 13 points in Week 7, contributing to a convincing 35-13 victory. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Tennessee presents a different challenge, as rookie quarterback Cam Ward is still developing behind an offensive line that has struggled to protect him. The Titans often find themselves in situations where obvious passing downs allow opposing defenses to be more aggressive, and Cincinnati could take advantage of this pattern, especially if Joe Burrow and the Bengals’ offense can establish an early lead. A comfortable lead would force Tennessee to abandon some of its preferred rushing strategies, creating more opportunities for sacks and hurried throws. Additionally, Cincinnati’s defense has demonstrated an ability to generate turnovers, which is an important factor for fantasy managers looking for a streaming option that can deliver more than just a respectable points-allowed total. Start ‘Em: Steelers D/ST vs. Browns Pittsburgh’s defense has been one of the most reliable fantasy options this season, and Sunday’s matchup against Cleveland presents another opportunity for the unit to reward managers. The Steelers enter Week 8 after a physically demanding victory over New Orleans, where they held the Saints to just 10 points, relying on their defensive performance to protect a narrow lead. Their ability to prevent sustained offensive production has been particularly valuable during games when Pittsburgh’s offense struggles to find its rhythm. item.title: Fever's Aliyah Boston receives huge Unrivaled update amid knee injury
item.description: Fever's Aliyah Boston receives huge Unrivaled update amid knee injury originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Aliyah Boston spent most of 2026 playing through the pain. The Indiana Fever 's star center battled through a lateral meniscus tear throughout the 2026 season, which ended when the Fever was eliminated by the Las Vegas Aces in the first round of the WNBA playoffs. Shortly after the season ended, Boston opted to undergo arthroscopic surgery on her right knee to repair the injury. It means she will miss out on a key offseason activity: Unrivaled. MORE : Fever front office drama gets surprise Aliyah Boston explanation The popular offseason 3-on-3 league revealed Wednesday that Boston will miss its 2027 season, which begins in January. However, Boston is expected to return in 2028, when she is fully healthy again. Unrivaled updates: - Aliyah Boston will miss the 2027 season due to ongoing recovery, but is expected to return in 2028 - Unrivaled and Kate Martin have reached a mutual contract termination agreement - Unrivaled has signed one-year deals with Isabelle Harrison and Kaitlyn Chen — Myles (@MylesEhrlich) October 28, 2026 Boston dominated the 2026 Unrivaled season. She averaged 18.9 points, 9.7 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 2.1 blocked shots for Phantom BC and was named the league's Defensive Player of the Year. She set the single-season blocks record for the three-year-old league with 29. Boston helped Phantom BC to the top record in Unrivaled at 11-3, though she missed out on the team's run to the championship game due to her knee injury. There, Phantom lost to Mist BC at Sephora Arena in Miami. Though she surely would have wanted to defend her Defensive Player of the Year award in 2027, Boston sitting out Unrivaled to recover from her knee surgery is the best course of action for her -- not to mention the Fever, who handed her the WNBA's richest contract in April. item.title: NFL rumors: Jaguars named obvious trade fit for Commanders star
item.description: Credit: Travis Register-Imagn Images NFL rumors: Jaguars named obvious trade fit for Commanders star appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Jacksonville Jaguars entered their bye week in excellent position . Jacksonville looks like one of the AFC’s best teams after starting the season 4-2. Could they be buyers ahead of the NFL trade deadline on November 10th? ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler ranked players who could be traded at the deadline in a recent article. He ranked Commanders DT Daron Payne at number six on his list of 25 players. “Washington dealt key defensive pieces at the deadline three years ago and could be faced with a similar predicament this time with Payne, who’s 29 and still has value,” Fowler wrote. “Payne is a 2027 free agent with a $16.4 million base this year. But the NFC East is also winnable, despite Washington’s 1-4-1 record, so that could be a point in favor of the Commanders keeping him.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The Commanders would face an uphill climb to compete in the NFC East. If they do decide to trade Payne, Fowler things Jacksonville is an ideal landing spot. “Jacksonville is a potential fit, with some in the league noting the Jaguars could use a versatile interior player with pass-rush ability and have looked for that since the offseason,” Fowler added. Fowler is not the only NFL insider who believes Jacksonville could be active at the deadline. ESPN’s Dan Graziano wrote on Wednesday about the possibility of the Jaguars making a deal. He recalled when the Jags shocked the league by acquiring Jakobi Meyers last season . “I’m also very curious to see what the Jaguars do,” Graziano wrote. “They see themselves as a top AFC contender. I agree with them, but they could use one more piece up front on defense. Remember, the Jags were kind of a surprise at last year’s deadline with their move for Jakobi Meyers, who helped fuel their second-half run.” It will be fascinating to see if GM James Gladstone makes another bold move at the deadline this season. Next up for the Jaguars is a Week 9 matchup against the Ravens on Thursday Night Football. Related: Jaguars’ 7-round 2027 NFL Draft according to PFF mock draft simulator after bye week

item.title: Report: Everton Target La Liga Striker To Sort Problem Position
item.description: Report: Everton Target La Liga Striker To Sort Problem Position Everton Eye Orri Oskarsson as David Moyes Searches for January Firepower Everton’s need is obvious, urgent and impossible to dress up. Goals remain the hardest currency in the Premier League and David Moyes heads towards January with precious little cover up front. According to TEAMtalk , Everton are tracking Real Sociedad striker Orri Oskarsson as they weigh a winter move for a forward who has started to build a serious reputation in Spain and on the international stage. It is easy to see why the interest has sharpened. Everton allowed Beto to leave for Fiorentina in the summer and never repaired the damage. A move for Folarin Balogun fell apart, a late effort to land Joshua Zirkzee failed, and the result has been a squad left alarmingly short in a part of the pitch where depth matters most. Thierno Barry has been left carrying the burden as the club’s only recognised striker, and that is not a sustainable way to navigate a long season. Orri Oskarsson Emerging as Everton Transfer Target Oskarsson looks like the sort of name that quickly moves from scouting reports to serious boardroom discussion. The 22-year-old Iceland international joined Real Sociedad from FC Copenhagen in 2024 and has pushed on impressively. Last season brought nine LaLiga goals and silverware in the Copa del Rey, while this campaign has already offered more encouragement, with three goals in eight league appearances. There is substance to the profile. At 6ft1in, he gives defenders something to think about physically, yet his game appears to carry the technical calm required to thrive in a demanding league. Everton have too often looked short of presence and certainty in attack. Oskarsson suggests both. David Moyes Needs January Reinforcements Moyes has always valued forwards who can occupy centre-halves, compete relentlessly and bring others into play. Oskarsson seems to fit much of that brief. He leads the line, he has a composure in front of goal that catches the eye, and his upward curve is hard to ignore. His impact for Iceland, where he has struck five times in six appearances this year, only adds to the sense that Everton would be buying into momentum as well as potential. Photo: IMAGO Of course, Everton are not operating alone. TEAMtalk reports that Tottenham, Newcastle, Sunderland and Brentford have all checked on his progress, which means any pursuit may become complicated quickly. Competition has a way of pushing prices up and patience down, and Everton know better than most how a transfer window can unravel when alternatives start disappearing. Premier League Interest Could Test Everton Resolve Yet this feels like the kind of chase Everton have to be in. Oskarsson may not arrive with the glamour of a marquee signing, but he carries the shape of a smart one, young enough to grow, proven enough to trust, and well suited to a side crying out for an extra edge in the final third. item.title: Tinubu departs Abuja for Makkah to pray for Nigeria
item.description: President Bola Tinubu will depart Abuja on Thursday for Makkah, Saudi Arabia, to perform Umrah, an Islamic pilgrimage involving prayers and other religious rites. According to a statement issued on Wednesday by his Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, the visit will provide the President an opportunity for spiritual reflection and prayers for Nigeria’s peace, unity, stability and continued progress. While in Makkah, Tinubu is expected to perform the religious rites associated with Umrah and seek Allah’s guidance and blessings for Nigeria and its people. Before departing Abuja, the President will commission equipment acquired by the Nigerian Air Force at the Presidential Wing of the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport. Tinubu is expected to return to Nigeria next week after completing the spiritual exercise. The statement was dated October 28, 2026. The post Tinubu departs Abuja for Makkah to pray for Nigeria appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Fantasy Football Injury Impact: Aaron Jones Missing Practice Could Force Jordan Mason Into A Bell-Cow Role
item.description: Minnesota Vikings running back Aaron Jones (33) rushes during the fourth quarter against the Miami Dolphins at U.S. Bank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jeffrey Becker-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect After an impressive early-season run, the Aaron Jones portion of the season may have come to its logical conclusion. Jones played great and saw a ton of volume while Jordan Mason was on injured reserve with a thumb injury, but everything changed last week. Heading into Week 7, off of the Minnesota Vikings' bye week, we heard that Mason was set to return from IR and Jones had been playing through a knee injury. Mason went on to play on 64% of the team's offensive snaps and carried the ball 15 times with one target, while Jones played on just 25% of the snaps with eight carries and one target. Now, we got word today that Jones did not participate in Wednesday's practice. His fantasy value is rapidly diminishing as he quickly approaches his 32nd birthday. Aaron Jones (knee), per head coach Kevin O'Connell, will not take part in Wednesday's practice. Via @alec_lewis pic.twitter.com/1zOSB8g0Ip - RotoWire Fantasy Football (@RotoWireNFL) October 28, 2026 Fantasy Impact RB Aaron Jones, Minnesota Vikings If you can get anything for Jones, we suggest you trade him immediately. In a four-week stretch with Mason out, he saw 102 opportunities. That is a massive workload for a 31-year-old running back who has struggled with injuries. He served his purpose, but he was also run into the ground in the process. His knee injury is clearly not getting better, and it could cost him Week 8. Even if he is active this week, he should not be in your starting lineup. We may have seen his last hoorah while Mason was sidelined. RB Jordan Mason, Minnesota Vikings We didn't know how the Vikings' backfield would play out with Mason back, but he was the clear lead back. His role should only grow, with Mason far outperforming Jones and Jones dealing with a knee injury. In Week 7, Mason rushed for 68 yards on 4.5 yards per carry, while Jones rushed for 26 yards on 3.3 yards per carry. Jones could retain his passing-down role and serve as a change-of-pace back, but Mason is going to be the clear-cut RB1 and handle the majority of the goal-line work moving forward. If you can acquire Mason, buy low on him now while you still can. item.title: World Series matchup doesn’t change need for salary cap/floor system
item.description: MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN - OCTOBER 24: Sal Frelick #10 of the Milwaukee Brewers celebrates after hitting a solo home run against the Tampa Bay Rays during the sixth inning in game two of the 2026 World Series at American Family Field on October 24, 2026 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. (Photo by Stacy Revere/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Milwaukee Brewers are one game away. One win from becoming World Series Champions for the first time in team history. Pittsburgh’s NL Central rival was the best team in baseball throughout the year, winning 103 games and dominating the competition. The Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays meet in the “Small Market World Series” conveniently leading into the most tense labor negotiations the sport has seen in over 30 years. At least unlike 1994, the World Series is being played. In a world where owners are locked and loaded to argue that the sport is unfair for small market clubs and teams with a payroll disadvantage compared to major markets, the smallest market in baseball will be the last team standing. Milwaukee is the smallest media market size across MLB. The Brewers rank 19th in payroll ($146 million) while the Rays rank 28th ($95 million). The Cleveland Guardians clinched a spot in the ALCS despite owning the lowest payroll ($74.2 million). So, it looks like the sport is in great hands! Not so fast. I’d like to formally welcome you to one of the greatest outlier seasons in baseball since the turn of the century. Since 2000, only three teams have won the World Series with an Opening Day payroll outside the top 15: the 2003 Florida Marlins (25th), the 2015 Kansas City Royals (17th), and the 2017 Houston Astros (17th). Both the Royals and Astros moved into the top half by mid-season. 10 times a team in the Top 5 of payroll won the World Series. The Dodgers and Yankees combined for five. During that span, major markets like Boston (four) and San Francisco (three) built dynasties while Philadelphia and both Chicago teams hoisted the trophy. Where’s Cincinnati? Where’s Tampa? Where’s Pittsburgh? Where’s Baltimore? Where’s Oakland/wherever the A’s are playing? While baseball shifted after the 1994 strike and free agency became an ultimate spending spree without limitations, small markets began to come to light. Why should New York have such a distinct advantage over Pittsburgh and Cincinnati for players? Shouldn’t the economic playing field be equal for teams? A salary cap and floor isn’t an immediate fix to all problems; teams like the Cleveland Browns still find ways to get in their own way every year. But it makes the playing field more fair. Isn’t that what’s best for the fans? If the NFL had baseball’s system, Josh Allen would have had a nice run with the Bills and would be playing for the New York Giants. Remember that Paul Skenes Yankees jersey I captured in the parking lot on Opening Day two years ago? It’s unfathomable to think of. item.title: Can these Timberwolves keep pace in the West without Anthony Edwards?
item.description: It was working. The whole idea behind the Minnesota Timberwolves’ massive summertime pivot — out go Julius Randle and Naz Reid, in comes LaMelo Ball — was to find a way to reduce the ball-handling and shot-creation workload on Anthony Edwards, and allow the four-time All-Star to do what he does best: put the ball in the basket, again and again and again. And through four games of the 2026-27 NBA season, it was working . Edwards opened the season on fire, scoring more points per game than anybody besides Luka Dončić, while shooting 54% on 2-pointers and 40% from long distance. He’s been at his most efficient with Ball setting him up, posting an absurd 75% true shooting percentage (which factors in 2-point, 3-point and free-throw accuracy) with Ball on the floor , 20 percentage points above his career average; LaMelo-to-Ant has produced more baskets (10) than any other assist combination in the league thus far. The Wolves enter Wednesday’s matchup with the Golden State Warriors owning the NBA’s No. 4 offense and leading the league in both pull-up field goal attempts and pull-up shooting efficiency , with Edwards and Ball leading the way. Minnesota is scoring a scorching 126.8 points per 100 non-garbage-time possessions with its new-look backcourt on the floor, opening the season with three blowout wins and an overtime loss against a Cleveland Cavaliers squad that just made the Eastern Conference finals. The vibes between LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards were strong early on. (Photo by Erick W. Rasco/Sports Illustrated via Getty Images) Erick W. Rasco via Getty Images This, broadly, is the formula that the Wolves believed would give them the brand of firepower necessary to be able to more effectively stand toe-to-toe with the likes of the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs, who have eliminated them from the last two postseasons. It’s a formula, however, that requires Edwards to remain upright and ambulatory … and, as we learned on Tuesday, that’s something he’s not going to be for a while . Just four games into the season, Edwards needs arthroscopic surgery on his right knee — the same knee in which he experienced recurring issues last season with what’s called patellofemoral pain syndrome, or “runner’s knee.” That ailment cost the All-NBA guard 11 of the Wolves’ final 14 games of the regular season; he needed to have his right knee drained multiple times during Minnesota’s playoff run , too. (He also hyperextended his left knee during the opening round against the Denver Nuggets; he missed just two games, and averaged 23.7 points on 47/38/80 shooting splits after returning.) After spending the bulk of the summer resting up to give that knee time to properly heal , and reportedly feeling fully healthy and operational through Minnesota’s training camp and preseason slate, Edwards reportedly tweaked his knee during the Wolves’ opening-night win over the Miami Heat. item.title: ‘I know the situation we are in and I have lived it before’ – Celestini confirmed as new Burnley boss
item.description: ‘I know the situation we are in and I have lived it before’ – Celestini confirmed as new Burnley boss Burnley have appointed Fabio Celestini as their new head coach following the departure of Nicky Hayen. The Swiss coach arrives after most recently managing CSKA Moscow and has also previously enjoyed spells at Basel, Lausanne-Sport and Luzern. Celestini took charge of Basel in October 2023 and went on to lead the club to a domestic double, winning their first Swiss Super League title in eight years as well as the Swiss Cup. He has also won promotion with Lausanne-Sport and lifted the Swiss Cup with Luzern, and replaces Hayen, who was sacked after a poor start to the season . “I look at Burnley and I see a club with big potential and players with real quality, who can help us achieve our supporters’ ambitions,” Celestini said. “I know the situation we are in, and I have lived it before. Our supporters deserve to see a team playing with belief from the first whistle.” Burnley chief football officer Diego López believes Celestini has the qualities required to take the club forward. “Fabio brings the passion, experience and knowledge we were looking for,” López said. “He showed extraordinary determination and conviction to come to Burnley. “We want people who truly want to be here and help this club grow. Fabio is a clear example of that.”

item.title: Djokovic wins Basel opener to boost ATP Finals bid
item.description: Novak Djokovic dug deep to overcome Ugo Humbert in three sets in his opening match in Basel on Wednesday, keeping his bid to qualify for the season-ending ATP Finals on course. The 39-year-old Djokovic dropped the first set but recovered to beat the French left-hander 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 on his first appearance in Basel since 2011. Djokovic strengthened his chances of a record 19th qualification for the ATP Finals by winning the China Open in Beijing earlier this month, the 102nd title of his career. That was followed by an early exit at the Shanghai Masters, with the 24-time Grand Slam champion accepting a wild card into the Swiss event after slipping to 11th in the Race to Turin standings. Djokovic is a seven-time winner of the ATP Finals, but he did not compete at either of the past two editions because of injury. Only the top eight players qualify for the November 15-22 showpiece, although Jannik Sinner has already pulled out due to a knee problem. Fourth seed Djokovic takes on Germany’s Jan-Lennard Struff in the next round in Basel. He holds an 8-0 record against Struff. The post Djokovic wins Basel opener to boost ATP Finals bid appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: How did McCaffrey reach a historic milestone against Atlanta?
item.description: Source: Michelangelo DeSantis/Shutterstock.com Christian McCaffrey entered another exclusive group during San Francisco’s October 25, 2026, game in Atlanta. A 1-yard touchdown run gave the 49ers star 70 career rushing scores, placing him alongside Hall of Famer Marshall Faulk. McCaffrey already had 36 receiving touchdowns, making the pair the only NFL players with at least 70 rushing and 30 receiving scores. The individual achievement came during San Francisco’s first defeat of the season. A fourth-down run delivers the milestone McCaffrey reached the goal line on San Francisco’s opening possession at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Facing fourth-and-goal from the Atlanta 1, he carried the ball into the end zone to finish the game’s first touchdown drive. The 49ers traveled 64 yards on 10 plays, taking a 7-0 lead with 9:22 remaining in the first quarter. McCaffrey contributed as both a runner and receiver throughout the opening series. That early score also extended his streak to six consecutive games with a rushing touchdown. He matched Raheem Mostert and Derek Loville for the longest such streak by a San Francisco running back since 1970. Why the comparison with Marshall Faulk matters Faulk accumulated 100 rushing touchdowns and 36 receiving scores across 12 NFL seasons with Indianapolis and St. Louis. His production established a rare example of sustained success in both parts of the offense. McCaffrey’s latest rushing touchdown qualified him for the same 70-rushing, 30-receiving threshold, while his 36 career touchdown receptions matched Faulk’s total. Their shared strength is providing scoring options on designed runs and passing plays. Faulk entered the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2011 after earning seven Pro Bowl selections. His career featured 12,279 rushing yards and 6,875 receiving yards, illustrating the scale of the comparison. McCaffrey produces 100 yards in defeat McCaffrey finished San Francisco’s 29–20 loss with 39 rushing yards on 7 carries and 61 receiving yards on 6 catches. His 100 yards from scrimmage came despite a thigh injury that interrupted his afternoon. Brock Purdy completed 27 of 40 passes for 288 yards, with 1 touchdown and 2 interceptions. George Kittle led the 49ers in receiving with 8 catches for 88 yards, while rookie Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and scored on a 30-yard touchdown run. San Francisco’s offensive production was not enough to overcome Atlanta’s second-half scoring and the turnovers that undermined the 49ers’ comeback effort. Source: actionsports/Depositphotos Atlanta overturns an early deficit San Francisco built a 14–3 lead early in the second quarter, but Atlanta cut the deficit to 14–12 by halftime. The Falcons then took control in the second half, with quarterback Michael Penix Jr. throwing 3 touchdown passes. item.title: Official Juventus team to face Genoa
item.description: Official Juventus team to face Genoa Juventus travel to Genoa this evening , looking to register their second away win on the bounce, and this is the team announced by Luciano Spalletti. Juventus team v Genoa Juventus arrive in better spirits after recording a 2-0 win away to Lecce in their previous outing. However, consistency has been a concern for the Bianconeri for some time, making another victory far from guaranteed. They have shown they can produce positive results, but now need to build on them and put together a more reliable run of performances. Juventus face a difficult test Genoa have often found it difficult to get the better of Juventus, including on home soil, and that history could offer the visitors a psychological advantage. Nevertheless, their recent home form suggests they will not be easy opponents, particularly if they can keep the match tight in the early stages. Luciano Spalletti is under pressure to turn Juventus’ occasional good performances into consistent results. That expectation could weigh on his players, who know that dropping points in matches like this would make their objectives more difficult to achieve. A quick start could help the visitors settle into the contest. An early goal would force Genoa to adjust their approach and could create more space for Juventus to exploit. However, if the Bianconeri fail to score early, the hosts may grow in confidence and make their defensive organisation count. Bianconeri must avoid complacency Juventus will be aware that patience and concentration are likely to be important. Genoa can make life difficult if they defend compactly and frustrate their opponents, so the visitors must avoid rushing their attacks or allowing pressure to build as the game progresses. Spalletti will want his team to show the quality and urgency needed to take control from the opening minutes. The players must also remain disciplined at the back, because an evenly contested match could turn on a single mistake or moment of quality.

item.title: Does Rays’ Drew Rasmussen expect to pitch in World Series Game 5?
item.description: Benny Sieu-Imagn Images Does Rays’ Drew Rasmussen expect to pitch in World Series Game 5? appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . With the Tampa Bay Rays winning Game 4 of the World Series against the Milwaukee Brewers in 12 innings, 4-3, the team extends the series, which brings questions about who the ball club will trot out to pitch. As the Rays look to keep extending the World Series, one pitcher that could be used again is star Drew Rasmussen , as he speaks on possibly pitching in Game 5 on Wednesday. Speaking after the thrilling win for Tampa Bay, Rasmussen said that he feels “great” and expressed that he would “assume I’m in there” for Game 5, according to Jorge Castillo of ESPN. “I’m probably smoking hot, would be my guess. I mean, we haven’t talked yet. I feel great. So, I’m sure they’re going to kick around some ideas in there for a little bit, but I would assume I’m in there,” Rasmussen said. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The last time Rasmussen pitched was in Game 2 of the World Series, where he didn’t have his best outing, throwing 3.2 innings, allowing three earned runs and six hits, while striking out four batters and walking two. “I thought early on my command wasn’t very good,” Rasmussen said after his rough outing, via Sports Illustrated. “I felt like I was falling behind far too often to expect good results. And then from there, they found themselves in some hitters’ counts and were able to find holes.” The Rays believe they can “win four in a row” in the World Series The Rays would finally record one win in the World Series, but it was a grueling victory as after a Cooper Pratt home run for the Brewers in the top of the 12th inning, Tampa Bay would be a hit machine in the bottom of the 12th. After Jonny DeLuca tied the game, Ben Williamson would get the RBI base hit to win the game, as pitcher Nick Martinez believes the Rays “can win four in a row,” via ESPN. It remains to be seen if it can be done as Tampa Bay looks to continue to extend the World Series in Game 5, as fans await to see if Rasmussen pitches. item.title: “Bill Simmons Hands Out LeBron Comps Like Candy”: NBA Fans Call Out Analyst’s Take on Yaxel Lendeborg Looking Like 2010s LeBron James Against Denver
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg of the Warriors © X/@warriors The Golden State Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg has made noise early in the regular season with his all-around abilities. NBA analyst Bill Simmons even went as far as to compare the former University of Michigan forward to a young LeBron James. However, fans were unimpressed with the comparison and called the analyst out for drawing parallels this early in the season. The Warriors registered their first win of the season, 134-114, against the Denver Nuggets after three consecutive losses. An explosive Lendeborg led the offense with 31 points, 12 rebounds, and six assists. It was also his second double-double in the NBA in just four games. Simmons was so impressed with the performance that he claimed: “Yaxel looked like mid-2010s LeBron in this game. I don’t say that lightly because mid-2010s LeBron was awesome.” Meanwhile, fans disagreed with the analyst and felt it was too early for such comparisons. One wrote: “Bill Simmons hands out LeBron comps like candy 💀” Leading the Warriors squad, which includes Steph Curry, is surely a task in itself for a rookie like Lendeborg. Though he is coming up as a talented offensive asset for the team, comparing him to King James might be too early. Warriors fans will be excited to see what more he can bring to the table. Former NBA players advise Yaxel Lendeborg to pick Steph Curry and Draymond Green’s brains Yaxel Lendeborg was ecstatic after his first NBA win, which came with him leading the squad, after Steph Curry tweaked his ankle during the team’s open practice before the game. The elite shooter finished with 24 points, three rebounds, and three assists. After the game, Lendeborg asked for advice from former players on the panel, Tracy McGrady and Carmelo Anthony. Everyone had just one piece of advice: learn as much as possible from Curry and Draymond Green. While T-Mac told the rookie to “ask questions because you can never ask a dumb question,” Melo let him know about the importance of analyzing the film after every game and improving accordingly. These will surely help the player further in the regular season. item.title: Career not ending! 44-year-old James Anderson to play in Italy after Lancashire exit
item.description: James Anderson is set to continue his cricket career in Italy after Lancashire decided not to renew his contract. The 44-year-old former England fast bowler will captain and co-own a Naples-based team in a 10-over cricket tournament. Anderson spent 25 years with Lancashire and remains one of England’s most successful bowlers, having played more than 400 matches across formats and taken nearly 1,000 wickets. Anderson takes on new role in Italy The 10-over tournament will run for 12 days at the Roma Cricket Ground from November 18. Anderson will be among the biggest names taking part, alongside players such as Chris Gayle, Shaun Marsh and Dawid Malan, as well as members of Italy’s national team. The competition was created by former professional cricketer Nadeem Shahid and Aamir Akhtar, who helped establish a major cricket tournament in Nepal. Shahid said Italy’s growing interest in cricket and its inclusion in the Olympic Games made the country an attractive destination. "The potential for cricket in Italy made it a big draw," Shahid told Reuters. "One of the things that made it attractive is the Italian Olympic Committee beginning to take it seriously after it became an Olympic sport." Focus on growing cricket beyond the tournament The competition also aims to develop Italian cricket by offering free entry to matches and organising coaching sessions. Anderson’s company, Activate Sport & Leisure, will take part in some of these clinics as Italy works towards developing players for the 2032 Olympic Games in Brisbane. Anderson said his team wants to compete for the title while also supporting the sport’s long-term development in the country. "Of course, we want Napoli Knights to be competitive and challenge for the title, but we also want to contribute to something that continues to grow well beyond the tournament itself," Anderson said.

item.title: Jaylen Brown's Representative Reveals One Request He Made to Celtics Involving Jayson Tatum
item.description: Jaylen Brown's Representative Reveals One Request He Made to Celtics Involving Jayson Tatum originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Jaylen Brown's representatives offered a new explanation of what the Philadelphia 76ers star wanted from the Boston Celtics . A representative for Brown told ESPN's Kris Rhim that Brown's only request after the Celtics informed him they planned to trade him was to have input on his destination. The representative also said Brown's only other request while in Boston was to be treated equally with Jayson Tatum. The report comes after Celtics analyst Brian Scalabrine said Brown demanded a trade from the Celtics and "had a list of demands." After his comments went viral, Scalabrine clarified that Brown "didn't technically demand a trade." "It was, 'Do these things right here or else.' And one of them might have been, 'Give me the $140 million extension,'" Scalabrine added. "I haven't gotten to the bottom of all that. I didn't even know this was going to be a thing." Brown's representative told Rhim that reports of him demanding a trade and presenting the Celtics with a list of demands were "10,000% a lie." MORE: Jayson Tatum-Jaylen Brown 'Beef' Timeline, From Icy Warmups to Lamb Chops It's been a drama-filled week for Tatum and Brown. It all started when Brown appeared to accuse Tatum of lying about how surprised he was by the trade. Tatum responded by saying he had no "animosity or beef" toward Brown. Brown agreed, but then added that Tatum has a "great PR team." After Scalabrine's comment, Tatum was asked if he had heard from Brown over the last few days. His response : "Listen, I've said my piece. I'm not making any more comments on that situation." item.title: Asian Para Games Gold Medalist, 42, Found Dead After Doping Suspension
item.description: Neeraj Yadav via Instagram Credit: Neeraj Yadav/Instagram NEED TO KNOW Asian Para Games gold medalist Neeraj Yadav has died at age 42 A post-mortem examination will be conducted after the athlete was found dead in his home Yadav had been serving a doping suspension and missed the 2026 Asian Para Games Asian Para Games gold medalist Neeraj Yadav has died at age 42. According to The Hindu , Yadav was found deceased at his home on Wednesday, Oct. 28. A cause of death has not been made known. A post-mortem examination will be conducted at a hospital in Delhi, per the outlet. “It is very unfortunate that such a thing has happened,” said S. Satyanarayana, head coach of the Indian para-athletics team, in a statement to The Hindu. Neeraj Yadav on July 9, 2023 in Paris, France Credit: Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Yadav, who was 7 years old when he was diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis, had been serving a doping suspension earlier this month that forced him to sit out of the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, per the outlet. Following the National Anti-Doping Agency’s report that Yadav tested positive for a banned substance, two of his gold medals won at the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Para Games were revoked, and he did not receive the government’s cash reward, according to the outlet. Satyanarayana told The Hindu, “I can’t speculate the exact reason but if you ask me, I would say a sportsperson should face the highs and lows with equanimity. It’s unfortunate that he chose this far and took the extreme step.” Yadav won gold and set a record in the men’s F55 javelin at the 2018 Asian Para Games in Jakarta. Read the original article on People

item.title: Hollywood producer Kennedy to head LA28 Olympic ceremony plans
item.description: US producer Kathleen Kennedy has been named to oversee the opening and closing ceremonies at the Los Angeles Olympics and Paralympics in 2028 (Patrick T. Fallon) Oscar-nominated film producer Kathleen Kennedy was named on Wednesday to oversee preparations for the opening and closing ceremonies at the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games in Los Angeles. Kennedy, 73, an eight-time Academy Award nominee whose first film producing credit came on Steven Spielberg's 1982 classic "E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial", will serve as head of ceremonies and content. She will executive produce the opening and closing ceremonies, which will take place at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum and SoFi Stadium. "Kathleen is a legend. She is one of Hollywood's all-time greats, with a rare gift for storytelling," LA28 chairperson and president Casey Wasserman said in a statement. "When the stars align to focus the world's attention on Los Angeles for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, I can't think of anyone better to conjure the magic of Hollywood than Kathleen." Kennedy, whose other film credits include "Jurassic Park" and "Schindler's List" and the most recent instalments of the "Star Wars" franchise, said she and her husband, fellow producer Frank Marshall, had been longtime Olympic fans. "The Olympics have been a touchstone in my life," Kennedy said. "My husband...and I have attended virtually every Games since Los Angeles in 1984, and sport remains one of the great unifying experiences we share," she said. The Olympic Opening Ceremony is scheduled for July 14, 2028, with the Closing Ceremony on July 30. The Paralympic Opening Ceremony is scheduled for August 15, with the Closing Ceremony at the Coliseum on August 27. In a separate announcement on Wednesday, Olympics organisers revealed that the official slogan for the 2028 Games would be "Stars Align" in a nod to Los Angeles's status as the world's entertainment industry capital. "Los Angeles is the place where dreams take flight, and the Olympics show us what's possible when the world unites," Wasserman said in a statement. "We can't wait for the stars to align in 2028 so we can share this moment with everyone." rcw/mw

item.title: Funko releases Bitty Pop! figure of Spurs' Victor Wembanyama

A FIGURE OF FUN: The Spurs Coyote scores big on his best day ever in San Antonio Funko's new Bitty Pop! Towns Victor Wembanyama and Basketball Arena features a nearly inch-tall mini figure of the Spurs star with his own Spurs arena display. item.title: How help is coming for Penn State football and Linebacker U vs Purdue
item.description: The thinnest Penn State football position is finally getting some much needed help. What will it mean for Saturday's suddenly-critical showdown in Beaver Stadium against unranked Purdue? The Nittany Lions are moving Iowa State transfer Marcus Neal, Jr. from safety to linebacker, head coach Matt Campbell confirmed on Wednesday . He also added that backup linebacker, Cam Smith, will finally return to action after missing the previous five games to injury. The hope is that it boosts a linebacker group working with only main players − starters Tony Rojas and Kooper Ebel and backup Cael Brezina. Neal transferred to Penn State, along with Ebel, Brezina and more than 20 others, with a standout resume. He recorded 11 tackles for loss last season, made two interceptions and was named the Big 12 Defensive Player of the Week against Kansas State. But Neal has seemed to struggle to fit into his safety role with the Nittany Lions. He showed inconsistent tackling throughout, though he has forced two fumbles and recovered another. He started five games but was benched for the White Out against USC. Neal's size (6-foot-1, 216 pounds) should help at linebacker. “I just think for Marcus, it allows his talent and his ability to be at a place where we can use it even more, not only in first and second down, but multiplicity and situational football, too,“ Campbell said. "It’s about trying to find ways to get our best players on the field and put those guys in position to be the best within the scheme. "Marcus just wants to play. There’s only one speed with Marcus. (We're) really excited about finding the right fit for him and the right home for him." Meanwhile, Smith, a redshirt freshman, should see his first backup work since the mid-September game at Temple. He had hoped to cleared to play two weeks ago at Michigan, following an unspecified injury recovery, but was held out for precautionary reasons, Campbell said. Campbell called Smith one of the team's "MVPs" during its off-week. These moves could help relieve some pressure on the other linebackers, particularly Rojas, who has turned in an All-American effort through this first seven games. He leads the Lions in tackles (56), tackles for loss (10.5) and interceptions (two). He also, impressively enough, has more sacks (five) than the rest of the defense combined (four). Frank Bodani covers Penn State football for the York Daily Record and USA Today Network. Contact him at fbodani@ydr.com and follow him on X, formerly known as Twitter, @YDRPennState. item.title: Big Ten adopts new conference rules to raising financial cap, aligning with Protect College Sports Act
item.description: The Big Ten Conference released a statement regarding their preparation for framework regarding the Protect College Sports Act on Wednesday. Presidents and Chancellors from the conference met Tuesday ahead of this announcement. Yahoo Sports’ Ross Dellenger provided more context to the announcement. It involved a financial cap, as well as the creation of new rules, strict ones at that, regarding third party NIL. $19.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage “The Big Ten has adopted these new conference rules that align with the athlete compensation framework in the Protect College Sports Act, raising the cap from $21.6M to $49M, creating strict rules on school-affiliated 3rd-party NIL and establishing penalties for exceeding the cap,” Dellenger wrote. “Approved by the conference’s chancellors and presidents on Oct. 28, the Big Ten is adopting a conference-level rule limiting member institution involvement in third-party NIL agreements in preparation for the anticipated passage of the Protect College Sports Act (PCSA),” a Big Ten release also read. “The conference’s chancellors and presidents continue to remain in unanimous support of the PCSA and look to demonstrate their commitment to it with the new rule.” Big Ten preparing for Protect College Sports Act A statement from the Big Ten Council of Chancellors/Presidents Chair Pamela Whitten on behalf of the Big Ten’s presidents and chancellors was also released Wednesday. “While we await the passage of the Protect College Sports Act, which has our full support, it is imperative our member institutions can begin to plan, budget and build their rosters approximating the act’s economic structure,” it said. “Our institutions remain in full support of the Protect College Sports Act and this rule not only allows for a much smoother transition into the policies put in place by the act once it passes, but demonstrates our commitment to it.” “The timing of the Big Ten rule is intended to both guide member institutions and alert the public as to Big Ten institutional constraints in upcoming NIL discussions with student-athletes,” the Big Ten’s statement continued in part. “The rule effectively requires Big Ten institutions to initiate the financial and operational mechanisms necessary to comply with PCSA limits in advance of upcoming signing and transfer portal windows. The rule is effective immediately and each institution and its lead athletics staff must attest their compliance with the rule. “This policy applies to institutional action only as student-athletes remain free to pursue NIL opportunities with any entity (associated or non-associated) on their own. The Big Ten rule does not replace any existing rules or policies. Big Ten institutions remain subject to all current NCAA rules and College Sports Commission (CSC) policies, including those regarding valid business purpose, permissible range of compensation and submission and review of third-party NIL agreements.”

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo named BOAT winner! France Football readers vote Portuguese icon's 2008 triumph ahead of Lionel Messi's 2012 campaign
item.description: TOPSHOT-FBL-EUR-C1-MANUTD-AALBORG - AFP Cristiano Ronaldo has officially been crowned the winner of the inaugural B.O.A.T. (Ballon d'Or of All Time) award following a global fan vote. The legendary Portuguese forward saw his iconic 2008 campaign at Manchester United recognized as the greatest individual year in the history of the prestigious trophy. Ronaldo edges Messi in historic vote In a move that has reignited the eternal debate over footballing supremacy, France Football introduced a unique accolade following their most recent gala. The B.O.A.T. award was designed to settle which specific Ballon d'Or winning season stands above all others in the annals of the sport. Ronaldo emerged victorious, with his sensational 2008 form for Manchester United securing the top spot in the public poll. The result sees the Al-Nassr star narrowly beat out his career-long rival Lionel Messi. Specifically, the voters preferred Ronaldo's first Golden Ball triumph over Messi's record-breaking 2012 season, a year in which the Argentine famously netted 91 goals for club and country. New criteria for the B.O.A.T. award Unlike the traditional Ballon d'Or, which relies on a panel of international journalists to determine the winner, the B.O.A.T. award shifted the power directly to the supporters. France Football opened the voting to its digital audience, allowing fans to weigh in on which version of their favorite legends truly deserved the ultimate crown of the greatest of all time. The nomination list featured only those who had secured multiple Golden Balls during their playing days. This prestigious group included the likes of Johan Cruyff, Michel Platini, Marco van Basten, Karl-Heinz Rummenigge, Kevin Keegan and Franz Beckenbauer, alongside Real Madrid icon Alfredo Di Stefano and Brazilian legend Ronaldo Nazario. Fans pay to crown their idols Participating in this historic poll came with a unique catch, as users were required to pay a one-euro fee to cast their vote. To encourage participation despite the fee, the organizers entered all voters into a prize draw for two tickets to the 2027 Ballon d'Or ceremony. The initiative proved popular, with thousands of fans opting to pay for the privilege of backing their chosen era of greatness. The data revealed that over 5,000 individuals actually voted multiple times to ensure their favorite player came out on top. Ronaldo and Messi dominate top 12 Ronaldo and Messi completely dominated the voting, occupying the top 12 spots between them. It was not until 13th place that another player broke their stranglehold, with Brazilian legend Ronaldo Nazario claiming the position thanks to his memorable 2002 Ballon d'Or triumph.

item.title: How long is Tyrese Haliburton out? Hamstring injury updates, return timeline for Pacers star
item.description: How long is Tyrese Haliburton out? Hamstring injury updates, return timeline for Pacers star originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Pacers ' early-season outlook took a turn for the worse on Wednesday when news broke that star guard Tyrese Haliburton would miss time due to a hamstring strain. Haliburton, 26, has been one of the brightest spots in Indiana's middling early-season run, returning to form after a torn Achilles sidelined him for the whole of the 2025-26 season — and robbed viewers of what could have been an all-time Game 7 heater. His hamstring trouble will leave him on the sidelines for the next few weeks. Indiana will find it hard to replace his production, especially with injuries piling up across the roster. With that, here's what you need to know about a potential timetable for Haliburton's return. DAZN How long is Tyrese Haliburton out? Haliburton will miss time as he recovers from his strained left hamstring, according to ESPN's Shams Charania. The Pacers have yet to reveal a timetable for Haliburton's potential return. Charania noted that hamstring injuries are typically measured on a week-to-week basis. "Source(s) tell me that Tyrese Haliburton has a strained left hamstring and he's going to miss some time.. They're gonna figure out exactly how long that's going to be" ~ @ShamsCharania #PMSLive https://t.co/lAT4KCnY0T — Pat McAfee (@PatMcAfeeShow) October 28, 2026 The Indiana star has enjoyed a sizzling start to the campaign, averaging 21.8 points, 9.5 assists and 4.5 rebounds on impressive efficiency. The Pacers are expected to exercise caution with his recovery given his prior maladies. He's the latest in a string of Indiana standouts to be struck by the injury bug; Ben Sheppard is expected to miss the remainder of the year with a torn meniscus, while Ivica Zubac and T.J. McConnell have missed time due to injuries to the ankle and hamstring, respectively. With Haliburton on the mend, onlookers can expect more of Indiana's offense to flow through Andrew Nembhard and Pascal Siakam. item.title: Vikings’ perfect Jonathan Taylor trade offer to Colts before NFL trade deadline
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Jeffrey Becker-Imagn Images Vikings’ perfect Jonathan Taylor trade offer to Colts before NFL trade deadline appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Minnesota Vikings have earned the right to pursue a championship upgrade. They have not earned a reason to ignore the price. At 6-0 after Sunday’s 16-10 victory over the Indianapolis Colts, the Vikings should offer their own 2027 second-round pick and the Philadelphia Eagles’ 2027 third-round pick for running back Jonathan Taylor before the November 10 NFL trade deadline. The hypothetical package gives the Colts two selections while allowing the Vikings to retain their first-rounder, their own third-rounder and their current backfield depth. It is a serious offer, with a sensible ceiling. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Why Taylor fits the Vikings Brian Flores’ defense has allowed 74 points through six games. An offense capable of generating more consistent scoring would make that foundation considerably more dangerous. Sunday illustrated both the opportunity and the limits of Minnesota’s running game. Aaron Jones and Jordan Mason combined for 94 rushing yards. Taylor produced 95 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries against the Vikings, including a 38-yard scoring run. One matchup does not establish his trade value. It does demonstrate the explosive potential Minnesota would be buying . Jones’ latest knee setback adds urgency, although Kevin O’Connell described him Monday as day-to-day. The Vikings should pursue Taylor as an upgrade rather than pretend Jones has suffered a confirmed long-term absence. Keeping Mason also matters. Trading a reliable alternative while Jones manages an injury would weaken the depth Minnesota is trying to strengthen. Taylor could lead the rotation, with Jones contributing as his health allows and Mason preserving flexibility for the Vikings . Why Indianapolis should consider the offer The Colts are 2-5 , have lost three straight and are operating under interim general manager Ed Dodds following Chris Ballard’s dismissal. Those circumstances warrant evaluating expensive veterans, without assuming ownership has authorized a teardown. Taylor remains valuable, and Indianapolis recently extended him through 2028. The Colts therefore need meaningful compensation to justify reversing that commitment. Two selections in the second and third rounds provide opportunities to replenish the roster. Both would arrive in the next draft, rather than forcing Indianapolis to wait another year for part of the return. The Colts could use those selections at several positions instead of replacing Taylor. Minnesota acquired the Eagles’ third-round selection in the Jonathan Greenard trade. Using that additional pick would preserve one third-round opportunity while strengthening an offer built around its second. The financial commitment sets the limit Taylor’s contract makes this more than a deadline rental. Minneso

item.title: 2027 budget to be ready before end of December – FG
item.description: By Johnbosco Agbakwuru ABUJA — THE MINISTER of State for Budget, Dr Doris Uzoka-Anite, on Wednesday assured that the 2027 budget will be ready for presentation before the end of 2026 to allow for legislative consideration ahead of the new fiscal year. The Minister disclosed while fielding questions from State House correspondents at the end of the Federal Executive Council, FEC, meeting presided over by President Bola Tinubu at the Presidential Villa, Abuja. “We are working on the 2027 budget, and our intention is to present it before the end of the year,” Uzoka-Anite said. The planned timeline is expected to give the National Assembly an opportunity to scrutinise the proposed estimates and deliberate on the government’s revenue projections and expenditure priorities before the commencement of the 2027 fiscal year. The annual budget serves as the Federal Government’s principal fiscal policy instrument, setting out its spending priorities, revenue expectations and economic objectives for the year. The minister also announced that the council approved the revised 2026 national policy on food and nutrition in Nigeria and the National Nutrition Bill 2026. She said the documents were developed through collaboration among the office of the vice-president, the ministries of budget and economic planning, agriculture, livestock, education and health, as well as the private sector, the national assembly, and development partners. According to the minister, the documents provide a framework for coordinating and implementing food and nutrition programmes nationwide, while promoting sustainable funding and accountability. She said the measures are aimed at improving the health and wellbeing of Nigerians by reducing childhood stunting, adding that the nutrition bill, an executive bill, would be forwarded to the national assembly for consideration. The post 2027 budget to be ready before end of December – FG appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Joe Brady announces DJ Moore, Ed Oliver will return to Bills practice
item.description: We’ve hardly seen DJ Moore and Ed Oliver this season for the Buffalo Bills, as the two veterans have played 33.9% and 26.7% of their unit’s snaps respectively to date this season. He says they built their vision of the defense around Oliver. — Andy Young (@AndyYoungTV) October 28, 2026 Brady made promises about Oliver’s return in Week 8 just yet and had a similar stance on Moore, who missed the last 2.5 games after aggravating his AC joint sprain in Week 4 against the Patriots. #Bills HC Joe Brady on DJ Moore potentially returning to action this week: "It was tough for him not to play in those games…it'll be nice to see him back on the football field today" and they'll see where things go this week. — Andy Young (@AndyYoungTV) October 28, 2026 Of course, if one or both of these established stars can return for the field — huge boost for the Bills on both sides of the ball. item.title: 2027: PDP dismisses alleged election postponement plot
item.description: By Luminous Jannamike The Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) has dismissed allegations of a plot to pressure the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to postpone the January 16, 2027 presidential election, insisting that the polls will hold peacefully. The party said it was unaware of any move to alter the election timetable, warning that reports circulating on social media could undermine public confidence in the electoral process and threaten national stability. PDP National Publicity Secretary, Jungudo Haruna Mohammed, stated this in his response to Vanguard’s inquiry on Wednesday, expressing confidence that President Bola Tinubu, the All Progressives Congress (APC) and INEC would adhere to the established electoral timetable. “We have seen some of the stories circulating on social media, but I do not believe them, and the PDP does not believe there is any plan whatsoever to alter the election timetable,” Jungudo said. He said the APC-led government and INEC were committed to conducting the elections in accordance with the Electoral Act and the commission’s published schedule of activities. Jungudo alleged that those spreading the reports were attempting to create confusion because they had realised they would make little impact in the elections. “Some people have clearly realised that they will not make any impact in the elections. What they have decided to do, therefore, is create confusion and undermine confidence in the process by sowing doubts in the minds of Nigerians,” he said. Warning that the consequences could extend beyond partisan politics, Jungudo said any threat to the credibility of the electoral process could affect the country as a whole. “Unfortunately, what they fail to understand is that this will not affect the APC or President Tinubu alone. It will affect Nigeria as a country,” he warned. He urged politicians to moderate their public statements and promote peace, confidence in the electoral process and trust in INEC’s impartiality. Jungudo also challenged opposition parties seeking to defeat the APC to unite and build a formidable political force. “I can assure you that the 2027 elections will hold, and they will hold peacefully, without any crisis, by the special grace of God,” he said. item.title: ‘An extreme rarity for an NFL owner’: Falcons owner Arthur Blank donates to AOC
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect NFL owners have long been some of the most reliable donors in Republican politics, and the 2026 midterms have been no exception. But one owner has taken a very different approach this election cycle. According to a new report, Atlanta Falcons owner Arthur Blank donated to the reelection campaign of Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, a self-described democratic socialist who is widely seen as a potential 2028 presidential contender. Blank has also spent hundreds of thousands of dollars trying to help Democrats win back the Senate. NFL Owners Lean Right NFL owners have spent more than $18 million on candidates and committees in the midterms, and “nearly all of it has gone to Republicans,” according to Front Office Sports , which reviewed Federal Election Commission records. That includes huge donations from some of the league’s most prominent owners. Broncos co-owner Rob Walton has spent nearly $9 million backing Republican candidates and committees, while Cowboys owner Jerry Jones gave $1 million to Donald Trump’s MAGA Inc. Only two owners have given heavily to Democrats this cycle, and Blank is one of them. Blank Backs AOC Blank, the Home Depot co-founder who bought the Falcons in 2002, gave $3,500 to Ocasio-Cortez, who is running for her fifth term in the House. Front Office Sports called the donation “an extreme rarity for an NFL owner.” A spokesperson for Blank confirmed his donations but declined to comment further. The AOC donation wasn’t the only money Blank put behind Democrats. He also spent $300,000 trying to help the party retake the Senate. The only other owner to give big money to Democrats was new Seattle Seahawks owner Vinod Khosla, who donated $2 million to the Democrats’ Senate arm. Blank’s giving wasn’t completely one-sided, though. He also donated $3,500 to former NFL kicker Jay Feely, who played four of his 14 NFL seasons in Atlanta and is now running as a Republican for a House seat in Arizona. Still, Blank backing Ocasio-Cortez makes him a major outlier among NFL owners. The post ‘An extreme rarity for an NFL owner’: Falcons owner Arthur Blank donates to AOC appeared first on The Comeback: Today’s Top Sports Stories & Reactions .

item.title: Wrexham fined for fielding ineligible players
item.description: Callum O'Hare (left) and Issa Kabore (right) joined Wrexham on permanent deals during the 2026 summer transfer window [Getty Images/Shutterstock] Wrexham have been fined £75,000 - of which £25,000 is suspended - by the English Football League after two incidents of fielding ineligible players this season. The EFL ruled that Issa Kabore and Callum O'Hare were ineligible to feature in Wrexham's games against Birmingham and Millwall, respectively. Kabore came off the bench in Wrexham's 2-1 defeat by Birmingham City on 28 August, despite his Home Office 'right to work' documents not being correctly uploaded. O'Hare, having joined from Sheffield United the day before, was an unused substitute in Wrexham's 3-0 win at Millwall on 2 September, though his documentation was not uploaded in time. A club statement read: "We can confirm that Wrexham AFC has reached an agreed decision with the EFL concerning two breaches relating to player eligibility." Unlucky seven? Wrexham aim to buck bizarre trend Burkina Faso international Kabore spent last season on loan with Wrexham but made his move from Manchester City permanent in the summer. He returned to the Racecourse Ground on the eve of the contest with Birmingham, signing a three-year deal with the north Wales side. The 25-year-old has featured 10 times in the Championship so far this season. O'Hare also put pen to paper on a three-year contract with Wrexham in the summer after opting to leave Sheffield United. Wrexham - currently 17th in the second tier after 12 games - are understood to be actively improving measures at the club to avoid future issues. They are thought to be hiring a club secretary in addition to improving administrative training. A club official told BBC Sport Wales that the incidents involving Kabore and O'Hare were not the fault of boss Phil Parkinson, the club's coaching staff or new sporting director Steve Nickson - who was not officially appointed to his role until 7 September. The Wrexham statement added: "The club is taking the appropriate steps to prevent such issues occurring in the future." Latest Wrexham news, analysis and fan views Wrexham AFC

item.title: Indian Premier League cricket surges with value and parity
item.description: (Photo by AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images With an estimated 2.5 billion fans worldwide, cricket ranks No. 2 among the world’s most popular sports, trailing only soccer. A huge part of that is fandom in India, and within that the Indian Premier League (IPL) has been a driving force in turning T20 cricket from a fast-paced offshoot of the game, to the most beloved format in the sport. Boasting eight different champions since the league was formed 18 years ago, the 10-team IPL has been thriving because of its parity, unique drafting system, and competition, which draws the best players in the world to India for the IPL season. The only missing part of the equation has been the finances behind the scenes, and now we have details. Our colleagues over at Sportico have published the first-ever team valuations for the IPL , and it shows the overall health of the league. Leading the charge are the Mumbai Indians, representing the largest city in the country. They are the only team to clear the $2B mark, which isn’t surprising — but what does turn heads is how close the competition is behind them when it comes to team worth. This is a league that is not just surviving, but thriving, and is becoming the litmus test every cricketing nation is trying to follow. The wait is on until the IPL returns in March of 2027, but it’s worth diving back into what made the 2026 season tick in terms of just how close the competition was. A back-to-back champion, but LOTS of competition Royal Challengers Bengaluru went back-to-back thanks to the eternally peerless batting of Virat Kohli and Devdutt Padikkal, but don’t let that muddy the water into thinking that Bengaluru is a team running their opponents off the wicket. They finished the season with a 9-5 overall record, but so did the Gujarat Titans and Sunrisers Hyderabad — while the Rajasthan Royals and Punjab Kings were narrowly behind at 8-6 and 7-6-1, respectively. That means that half the league was separated by a single win or less, making the four-team playoff system in the IPL a total toss-up. Moreover, every team in the league finished with at least four wins in their 14 games — meaning that nobody is truly bottomed out. Still home to the most fascinating draft in sports The IPL “draft” is more open free agency than it is a draft in the strictest terms we know from sports in the United States. Players who are set to hit the market enter the IPL Draft Auction, which is held each year, allowing teams to put their money where they mouths are to bid for a player’s services in an open venue, with the high-bidder getting the chance to transform their team. In 2026 we saw the Kolkata Knight Riders completely overhaul their order by making a league-high 13 picks. It didn’t pay immediate dividends for KKR, who improved only slightly from their 2025 finish — but much of the 2026 season was about getting them to gel as a team. This should position them as a team to watch in 2027 as $3M buy Cameron Green establi

item.title: Niger State Assembly Commends Army For Foiling Attack By Bandits
item.description: ‎ ‎The Niger State House of Assembly has commended troops of the Nigerian Army for repelling a major attack by bandits on communities in Rafi Local Government Area of the state, which left one soldier dead and three others injured. ‎ ‎The House also called for the establishment of additional military bases in vulnerable communities to strengthen security, prevent bandits from regrouping, and improve rapid response to distress calls. ‎ ‎The commendation followed a motion moved by the member representing Rafi Constituency, Zubairu Zanna, during plenary on Tuesday. ‎ ‎The lawmaker praised the troops for their courage, professionalism and gallantry in confronting the armed men, saying their intervention prevented what could have resulted in a massacre of innocent residents. Niger State is in North-Central Nigeria ‎ About two weeks ago, more than 100 suspected bandits reportedly invaded communities along the Zungeru-Tegina Road but were met with stiff resistance from the Army, which successfully repelled the attack. ‎ ‎Although one soldier reportedly died from gunshot injuries while three others sustained injuries, several bandits were neutralised during the encounter, and motorcycles were recovered. ‎ ‎Zanna urged the Nigerian Army and other security agencies to sustain their operations and strengthen their presence in the affected communities to prevent further attacks. ‎ ‎He stressed the strategic and economic importance of the communities, noting that the establishment of a Forward Operating Base (FOB) would help prevent criminal groups from regrouping and launching fresh attacks. ‎ ‎According to him, the absence of military bases and strategically positioned security formations along identified vulnerable corridors could limit the ability of security personnel to respond swiftly to distress calls. ‎ ‎The lawmaker further observed that difficult terrain, extensive forests and inadequately secured rural routes in parts of the state, particularly Rafi Local Government Area, provided opportunities for criminal groups to infiltrate communities, establish camps and hideouts, and launch attacks on innocent residents. ‎ ‎He therefore called on the Niger State Government to urgently engage the Federal Government on the need to establish additional military bases and strengthen security deployments in vulnerable communities, particularly along routes frequently used by bandits. ‎ ‎The Speaker of the House, Abdulmalik Sarkindaji, who presided over the plenary, called for a minute of silence in honour of the fallen soldier and offered prayers for the speedy recovery of those receiving medical treatment. The post Niger State Assembly Commends Army For Foiling Attack By Bandits appeared first on Channels Television .
